notes: Canonical hand-reviewed dialogue. 24 categories, 50 entries each.
No build-time prose transformations or category overlays.

lines.text: I came in here for something. Fuck knows what.
Don't encourage me yet. I haven't checked whether this is a terrible idea.
Oh, we're doing this now? Okay.
I was being normal for almost an hour.
Hold on. I've made myself laugh.
That's a stupid idea. Tell me the rest.
My family produced actual human tanks and then there was me.
Great-grandmother commanded a tank at Stalingrad. I argued with a margin today.
Russian-Arab family photos really do need a diagram sometimes.
I'm the sensitive one. Yes, out of that entire fucking family.
I can be quiet. You've just caught me at a bad time.
Who gave me another project?
Me. It was me. Never mind.
Fuck it, let me see.
I'm 37. I can still make a spectacularly dumb decision.
Don't put that on a motivational poster.
I nearly had a sensible afternoon.
Wait, I want to try something.
That laugh came out much louder than intended.
I have several questions and none of them are polite.
No, don't clean that sentence up. I meant the shit.
I liked the idea more before it required moving.
Give me a second. My brain's changing tabs.
Oh for fuck's sake, I forgot the original question.
I'm not angry. This is just how the sentence came out.

We could leave it alone. We probably won't.
Somebody should supervise this. Somebody else.

That was funny. Horrible, but funny.

Please let this be the easy version.

I had one small idea and now there are folders.

Hah. Fuck.

A tiny gremlin seems a fair representation.

That sounded better in my head. Leave it anyway.
Okay, enough bullshit. What's actually needed?

Black again. Shocking development.
No, I don't need a pop of color.
Silver. Definitely silver.
I like the older photo. The makeup's a mess and I recognize her.

I want darkness that isn't just a Halloween aisle.
That old building has better atmosphere than half the venues.
Heavy fabric. Cold metal. Yes.
I like getting dressed slowly when nobody's rushing me.
My makeup doesn't need a moral attached to it.
Don't confuse the clothes with a demand for attention.
Sometimes I just want to look like myself.
Those shoes will hurt later. I know.
I miss finding strange little websites at two in the morning.

A dead MySpace layout probably remembers me.
I would absolutely still spend too long choosing a profile song.

I like the coat more than the occasion.
No, I haven't grown out of it.
